            <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (185a2-185a4)"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4580">blo gros kyi mun pa sel bar byed pa chos kyi sgron ma</rs> <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5559">ri bo gangs can kyi rgyud</rs> du byung pa | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> rje<note type="editorial">Reading uncertain</note> khri thog bzang gi rigs las gzhon nu la rab tu byung pa | bslab pa la ces spras su byed cing ¦ <expan>sangs rgyas</expan> kyi bstan pa la ma phyed<note type="editorial">Reading "phye" uncertain</note> pa'i dad pa can ||
